library1.text:
```Among all the unwritten rules of a library, the Royal Academy has one more: never answer if someone calls your name from between the shelves. Even less during the Night of Veils.``` 
The E.R.A library, as impressive as always with its towering bookshelves, countless study halls, and arched ceilings. Whatever your opinion on studying and reading is, there's no denying the beauty and grandiose of the library. Now... where will you start?

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

halls.text: It's... a library. Tons of tables, even more chairs. It's quiet, as expected of a library.

choices.label: Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

halls2.text: A few tables are occupied by students, some of them writing something, some reading, but most of them looking deeply concentrated in whatever they were doing. It's best not to disturb them for now...

choices.label: Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

halls3.text:
At one of the end tables, you see a figure hunched over. Long, dark hair drapes over their face, hiding what they look like. They're not wearing the uniform, instead, they don a white dress.

Slowly, as if sensing your gaze, the figure turns slowly to look at you. They smile, slowly, uncannily, much too  w i d e.

(In hindsight, you'll recognize that this was an upperclassmen you see around the library all the time. Nerds can be pranksters too...?)

choices.label: Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

halls4.text: You notice something tucked beneath one of the study desks. Upon closer inspection, you find... `{{d6}}` candies! Someone must have stashed them here for later... but they're yours now...

choices.label: Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

halls5.text:
The librarian notices that you aren't here to study nor to read.

They promptly ask you to leave the library. Bye bye rumor...
```INVESTIGATION: END```

ground.text: You find yourself looking at the *History of Eirenhel* section. A lot of the books here are notacibly thick, likely holding several interpretations of Eirenhel's founding, the Capital and it's history, etc. Boring....

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

ground2.text:
Here you are, between the shelves. You stand still, hold your breath, and wait for something (or something) to call your name.

...

...

Nothing happens.

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

ground3.text:
You check one of the book return carts, expecting nothing more than a pile of books. 

And there is a pile of book! As a bonus, you also find `{{d6}}` candies in the cart.

Go to the backrooms

ground5.text:
Here you are, between the shelves. Nothing happens, nothing exciting. You pull out a book, when you hear something - it's voice so faint that you can't tell if it was real or not-

You hear something unfamiliar calling your name...something unnatural. It's gone before you know it.

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

ground6.text: Your eyes skim over titles related to the Kingdom's woodlands... and almost strangely enough, you spot small pieces of tree bark wedged between two books.

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Head straight to the upper floors
Go to the backrooms

ground7.text:
You pull out a book, but you must have moved it wrong- before you know it, multiple books come crashing down. It creates quite the scene.

Before you know it, you're kicked out of the library...
```INVESTIGATION: END```

upper.text:
You find yourself looking at the *Theology* section. Books full of the history of Vellune, books of prayer, there are even a few books on other religions. Maybe you should take one out and just pray instead of doing whatever it is you're doing now...
```INVESTIGATION: END```

upper2.text:
Here you are, between the shelves- there. You hear it. Someone is calling your name!

...

Hang on. That's just your classmate. Aw...
```INVESTIGATION: END```

upper3.text:
For some reason, something compels you to look on top of the bookshelves...

Boo! You find a plastic skeleton staring back at you.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

upper4.text:
You pull out one of the books to inspect it, when suddenly, `{{d6}}` candies fall along with it! Woah!
```INVESTIGATION: END```

upper5.text:
You check one of the book return carts. Nothing seems to be wrong with it. You reach down to grab a hold of one of the books-

Something cold seems to grip at your hand. It wraps around, *tugging*, which is odd - because you don't see anything at all holding you.

The feeling disappears after a few seconds.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

upper6.text:
Here you are, between the shelves. Nothing is happening... so you pull out a book. And when you do, you almost drop it in shock when you realize--

Something was watching you from behind the shelves.

It disappears before you can tell what it was.
```INVESTIGATION: END```

backrooms.text: A small maze of staff only rooms, including bookbinding and repair rooms, storage areas... anything where the library's books are sorted and maintained, whether through mundane or magic means.

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors

backrooms2.text:
*Scritch scratch.*

A quill scratches away on its own in the far corner of the book repair room. Letter after letter appears on the page, writing what seems to be... a curse?

...Not quite. 

A closer look reveals that the quill is enchanted to move on its own. The 'curse' is nothing more than meaningless scratches... seems like someone else got here before you.

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors

backrooms3.text:
You find yourself in an empty place with yellow walls and a yellow floor. There are no bookshelves. No doors. No windows. 

You blink --

And around you, is the library's cataloguing room. It leaves you wondering if you imagined the whole thing, but you swear it was real.

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors

backrooms4.text:
You make your way through the backrooms, and you smell it -- the faint scent of pine.

You notice smudges of mud on the wall and floor, too. 

...*strange*. This far inside the library, where could it possibly come from?

choices.label: Explore the reading halls
Go to the ground floor shelves
Head straight to the upper floors

backrooms5.text:
You shouldn't be here -- and the librarian silently standing right behind you is proof of it. 

When they finally catch your attention, they give you a stern warning before kicking you out of the room. Seems like you have no choice but to actually study if you want to stay in the library...
```INVESTIGATION: END```
